**3.52h**

Finished pcb, changed tier, and started readme.

ALSO THE ROUTING WAS SO DAMN HARD EITHER CAUSE THE DEV BOARDS PINS ARE REALLY CLOSE OR THE FOOTPRINT MAKER MADE MASSIVE PADS AND I COULDNT ROUTE BETWEEN THE PADSSSSSSSS.

- Not understanding I2c and spi protocols, and subsequently the optimal wiring for those protocols on the specific model of esp im using
